title: Cloud metadata
repositoryLabel: Open the PlayOut metadata repository (opens in your browser)
note: Corrections made with the pen on a game's page are shared through the PlayOut metadata cloud, a public GitHub repository every PlayOut reads without an account. A cloud correction replaces what the scrapers found; your own edit on this PC replaces both. Artwork is not part of it and stays on this PC.

relay.label: Suggestion relay URL
relay.usingShared: Using the relay the repository announces ({url}).
relay.note: The relay is the free Cloudflare Worker in metadata-relay (see its SETUP.md) that turns edits into pull requests for the maintainer. Leave it empty to use the one the repository announces.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.openLabel: Open suggestion {number} on GitHub (opens in your browser)

toasts.approved: {game}: approved; every PlayOut gets it with the next sync
toasts.relayShared: Relay URL shared; every PlayOut picks it up with its next sync
